lecture_beats.subject: Discrete review and continuous probability densities
Dirac delta and continuous position basis
Continuous Born rule and lattice normalization
Particle on a circle and normalized momentum eigenfunctions
Two-slit amplitudes, interference, and fringe geometry
Which-path detector and elastic momentum redirection
One-aperture envelope, diffraction, visibility, and wavelength
Aperture preparation, electron reuse, and deferred reversibility

resolved_source_issues.issue: Spoken language treats the delta partly as an infinitely tall function.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The spike is retained as intuition while the sampling identity is used as the precise distributional definition.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The continuum normalization and lattice labels are verbally compressed.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter makes the a to zero rescaling, overlap, and completeness relations explicit.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The discussion can be heard as applying periodic quantization to all angular momentum.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The result is identified as integer orbital angular momentum for scalar periodic wavefunctions; spin is separated.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Compatibility and the commutator are stated without operator-domain or Hermiticity qualifications.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter states the finite-dimensional spectral result, notes domain qualifications, and identifies the commutator as anti-Hermitian.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The local beat model and aperture diffraction are mixed in the spoken geometry.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter separates two-path fringe spacing from the single-aperture envelope and supplies the far-field scale.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Perfect zeros are described before unequal aperture amplitudes and experimental noise are considered.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The general unequal-amplitude intensity is shown and the idealization required for exact zeros is stated.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Reusing an electron and reversing a measured evolution become conflated.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Re-preparation is separated from full dynamical reversal involving the detector.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The source video is limited to 320 by 240 pixels.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Frames preserve board evidence while all equations and the two-path geometry are independently typeset.

uncertain_sources.note: The audio is garbled; the conclusion that position and momentum have no common eigenstates is clear from adjacent statements.
Some spoken signs are unclear; the product-rule derivation and final canonical commutator fix the standard expression.
